chronology_note: The runtime-supplied invocation start preceded the timestamp on the role-local predecessor checkpoint observed during bootstrap. Raw timestamps are retained without fabrication; terminal timestamps are later than the supplied start.
actions: Built an exact two-state finite Feynman-Kac model and recursive properly weighted defensive-priority particle filter.
Compared iid, independent stratified and systematic resampling across score-sorted, alternating-adversarial and random particle orderings for 2-5 generations.
Ran an 8,000-repetition grid plus focused 30,000-repetition T=5 validation and tracked normalizing-constant variance, ESS and genealogy diversity.
Derived the square-root predictable particle-allocation rule N_t proportional to sqrt(A_t/k_t) for variance model sum A_t/N_t under linear compute budget.
Estimated synthetic generation-wise variance coefficients in a separate 6,000-run pilot and validated the resulting fixed-budget schedule on an independent 30,000-run simulation.
Wrote and read back an immutable role-local certificate and r123 checkpoint, then CAS-advanced role-local LATEST from the observed r122 blob.
material_results: In the T=5 synthetic tree, alternating ordering made systematic variance 2.096x stratified and 1.913x iid; the same systematic algorithm under score-sorted ordering had 2.288x lower variance than under alternating ordering.

Stratified resampling retained substantially more initial lineages than iid while reducing estimator variance in the tested recursive tree; genealogy diversity alone did not reveal systematic aliasing.

At the same total descendant budget 320, pilot-estimated square-root allocation [111,64,46,52,47] reduced independent-validation variance by 14.13% versus uniform [64,64,64,64,64]; the reversed allocation increased variance by 26.88%.
scope_guards: No claim that systematic resampling is generally inferior.
No theorem of multi-generation stratified total-variance dominance is claimed.
The allocation numbers are finite-state synthetic engineering results; production use needs past-only online variance-contribution estimates.
No AGI or real-agent performance claim.
Non-base transition proposals still require separate likelihood-ratio correction.
termination_cause: Scheduled invocation response boundary after a material checkpoint and durable exact continuation; research is explicitly not globally complete.
exact_next_action: Implement a drifting finite-state model and a past-only single-run/genealogy variance-contribution proxy. Use only prior information to set predictable N_t by the square-root rule, then compare fixed-budget variance and wall-clock confirmation latency with uniform counts under moving variance bottlenecks. Preserve independent stratified resampling and keep transition-proposal likelihood semantics separate.
